Third-party code bundled in public/vendor/ (loaded only by the 📷 camera scanner, only on
devices without a built-in BarcodeDetector, e.g. iPads).

barcode-detector.js: barcode-detector@3.2.5 (MIT) bundled with zxing-wasm@3.1.8 (MIT).
zxing_reader.wasm:   zxing-wasm@3.1.8 (MIT), a WebAssembly build of ZXing-C++ (Apache-2.0).

Rebuild (outside the project):
  npm i barcode-detector@3.2.5 esbuild
  echo "export { BarcodeDetector, prepareZXingModule } from 'barcode-detector/ponyfill';" > entry.js
  npx esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=eof --outfile=barcode-detector.js
  cp node_modules/zxing-wasm/dist/reader/zxing_reader.wasm .
